text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — addressed the requested changes for PR #4231. Removed the deprecated flag, tightened input validation, and added a small unit test. Diff: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4231
Maya Rivera: quick nit — can we rename validate_input -> validate_request? feels clearer for the public API
Alex Chen: good call, renamed and pushed (squashed minor commits). Command I ran: 
```bash
git checkout mybranch && git pull && git commit --amend --no-edit && git push -f
```
Also snippet: 
```diff
- func validate_input(x) { ... }
+ func validate_request(x) { ... }
```
Jamal Patel: LGTM overall. One ask: TestRetry uses a 500ms sleep — can we switch to a fake clock to avoid flakiness? not blocking canary but prefer to avoid flakes
Alex Chen: yep switched to clock.Mock and updated the test, ran `./scripts/test -run TestRetry` locally and it passed
CI Bot: CI passed — build ✅ unit-tests ✅ lint ✅ (https://ci.internal/builds/4187659999)
Olivia Green: :thumbsup: Looks good to me, approving now
Tim Nguyen: heads-up — infra policy needs 2 approvers for changes touching the request API. Maya, can you give a quick approve so Tim can merge?
Maya Rivera: @Tim thanks — I'm good with this after the rename. Approving now
Tim Nguyen: great — I'll merge into canary during tomorrow's 09:00 PT window and watch metrics. Pinging @oncall for capacity awareness
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. Will monitor canary and roll back if we see regressions
